Aircraft.Instructions:
Scaley By: BaconEggs
Ag1: Main headlights Ag2: Foglights Ag3: Rear caution light Ag4: Switch between MPH & KM/H on the display
Notes: Production based racing car, mid-engined rwd drivetrain. Designed to have very forgiving handling, thus requiring very little funky trees assistance. The low floor and high downforce makes curbs and bumps dangerous at high speeds. Enjoy!
As a sidenote, if you know which real life racecar this is based on, you may have noticed this is a tad smaller than it should be. While I was setting the blueprints up, I used the wheel base width as the width of the picture, to which the wing mirrors offset the rest of the car and made me build an 89% scale version of it. I realized this while I was 2/3 the way done with the bodywork and I had to commit to the bit
